scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.llm:smoke: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run llm:smoke -w apps/server
scripts.adaptive:sim: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run adaptive:sim -w apps/server
